title: Actor meters
hook: **WIP:** actors share six pools — HP, stamina, sun/hunger, spirit, yang/yin, poise — the fuels skills and stances will spend. Not finished yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Designed and partly built. Poise and the full skill-cost loop are not finished — do not expect every pool as a live spend UI yet.
A shared actor pool. Faction difference is a **label** (plant vs zombie wording), not a different system.
The **lawn sun bank** in a match, and the plant **label** for the hunger meter. Different scopes — do not mix them.
Plant / zombie labels for stance and buff fuel — not a morality meter.
The guard pool. When it lands, guard is a real stance — not a free shrug.

alsoTrue: Health already matters everywhere; the unfinished part is spending the other pools on skills.
Skills that cost these meters are [skills and loadouts](skills-loadouts) — also WIP.

sections.title: Not finished yet
paras: When meters land, skills cost something you can see, and guard is a real stance.
Until then, treat missing spend UI as unfinished work — not a broken save.

sections.title: The six pools
sections.intro: Same system; plant and zombie only rename some rows:
sections.note: Do not confuse plant “Sun” on this table with the match’s lawn sun bank.

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Play with HP and the combat language that already ships — elements, shields, statuses.
Read this page as the map of fuels coming with skills and interactive battles.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Keep playing lawn and roster loops — meters are not a gate to start.
When meter UI appears, learn the six names and which label your side uses.
Separate lawn sun (match bank) from the plant hunger label named Sun.

mixUps.q: Where do I spend yang or poise?
mixUps.a: Not finished yet. Poise and the skill-cost loop are WIP.

mixUps.q: Is plant “Sun” the same as match sun?
mixUps.a: No. Match sun is the lawn bank. Sun on the meter table is the plant hunger label.

mixUps.q: Do plants and zombies use different meter systems?
mixUps.a: No. Same six pools — labels differ.

mixUps.q: Is this a stamina gate on the whole game?
mixUps.a: No. Design forbids a player stamina gate. These are actor combat pools.

mixUps.q: Do I need meters to finish a lawn match?
mixUps.a: No. Lawn play and shipped combat language already work.
